method.membership: scheduled departure time, not actual insertion time
method.completed_means: only arrived vehicles by simulation end; not a censoring-corrected overall mean
method.mean_stopped: all vehicles currently in the network, sampled every 2 s in [300,1500), speed <0.1 m/s
method.edge_speed: SUMO edgeData speed weighted by sampledSeconds in [300,1500)
method.validation: synthetic demand, one seed, one candidate, no pedestrian clearance or field validation
